This version contains a lot of little changes to improve the app's stability and performance. Please report any issues you find and thank you for using Waller!

[color=#4CAF50][b]New[/b][/color]
• New zoom-and-pan preview screen that remembers your crop and position when setting a wallpaper
• Set wallpaper button allows to choose between your Home or Lock screen
• Carousel Background service now auto-retries if it fails to start

[color=#82C8E5][b]Improvements[/b][/color]
• Better handling of large number of images for in-app carousel screen
• Better handling of High Res Images in App
• Faster startup: the app gets to its dark screen sooner

[color=#FFFF00][b]Fixes[/b][/color]
• App no longer crashes when a wallpaper file goes missing
• White gif spans while images load
• Home screen widget showing the wrong preview message
• Collapsed date groups now expand automatically when selection begins.
• Main select All button didn't know when all items were selected by hand, now it does
• Case of missing scrollviews in gallery and settings fixed
• Patches to Light theme
